spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  error_criticality,
  SUM(error_count) AS error_count
FROM data_quality_stats
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
GROUP BY error_criticality
ORDER BY error_criticality

SELECT
  ingestion_timestamp AS time,
  COALESCE(missing_values_count, 0) AS missing_values_count,
  COALESCE(type_error_count, 0) AS type_error_count,
  COALESCE(outlier_error_count, 0) AS outlier_error_count,
  COALESCE(consistency_error_count, 0) AS consistency_error_count,
  COALESCE(schema_error_count, 0) AS schema_error_count
FROM data_quality_stats
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
ORDER BY ingestion_timestamp ASC

SELECT
  ingestion_timestamp AS time,
  error_count
FROM data_quality_stats
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
ORDER BY ingestion_timestamp ASC

SELECT
  SUM(error_count) AS total_errors
FROM data_quality_stats
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

SELECT
  ingestion_timestamp,
  file_name,
  total_rows,
  error_count,
  error_rate,
  error_criticality
FROM data_quality_stats
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
ORDER BY ingestion_timestamp DESC

SELECT
  ingestion_timestamp AS time,
  COALESCE(missing_values_count, 0) AS missing_values_count,
  COALESCE(type_error_count, 0) AS type_error_count,
  COALESCE(outlier_error_count, 0) AS outlier_error_count
FROM data_quality_stats
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
ORDER BY ingestion_timestamp ASC

SELECT
  ingestion_timestamp,
  file_name,
  total_rows,
  error_count,
  COALESCE(missing_values_count, 0) AS missing_values_count,
  COALESCE(type_error_count, 0) AS type_error_count,
  COALESCE(outlier_error_count, 0) AS outlier_error_count,
  COALESCE(consistency_error_count, 0) AS consistency_error_count,
  COALESCE(schema_error_count, 0) AS schema_error_count
FROM data_quality_stats
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
ORDER BY ingestion_timestamp DESC

SELECT
  ingestion_timestamp AS time,
  (total_rows - error_count) AS clean_rows,
  error_count
FROM data_quality_stats
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
ORDER BY ingestion_timestamp ASC

spec.title: Clean vs Corrupt Rows Over Time (timeseries)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ingestion_timestamp AS time,
  error_rate
FROM data_quality_stats
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
ORDER BY ingestion_timestamp ASC

SELECT
  NOW() AS time,
  SUM(COALESCE(schema_error_count, 0)) AS schema_error_count
FROM data_quality_stats
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
